# `oira_meetings`

OIRA's EO 12866 meeting log: meetings OIRA held with outside parties about a rule under review, ingested from reginfo.gov's bulk XML exports by `build_oira_meetings`. One row per log entry, i.e. one requesting organization and contact for a meeting; a meeting with several requesting parties spans several rows. This is the only systematic record of outside contact on a rule before its text is public, for every agency except the FCC (see `fcc_filings` for FCC ex partes). Keyed by `rin`, so it joins to `oira_reviews`, `unified_agenda`, and `federal_register`. Scope: reginfo.gov publishes the meeting log as bulk XML only for 2024 (two half-year files), so this table covers meetings dated 2024 only; other years are only in reginfo.gov's HTML search. Rebuilt in full each run. All columns are VARCHAR.

- **Parquet file:** `oira_meetings.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `meeting_id` | `VARCHAR` | reginfo.gov meeting ID. Present only for rows from the second-half 2024 file; the first-half file omits it, so it is null there and is not a key. |
| `rin` | `VARCHAR` | Regulation Identifier Number of the rule discussed. Join key to `oira_reviews`, `unified_agenda`, and `federal_register`. |
| `agency_code` | `VARCHAR` | Acronym of the agency that owns the RIN (e.g. `FDA`), matching `unified_agenda.agency_code`. |
| `agency_name` | `VARCHAR` | Full name of the agency that owns the RIN, from reginfo.gov's agency list. Null when not listed. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Title of the rule discussed. |
| `rule_stage` | `VARCHAR` | Rulemaking stage at the time of the meeting (e.g. `Proposed Rule Stage`, `Final Rule Stage`). |
| `meeting_date` | `VARCHAR` | Date of the meeting (ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). |
| `meeting_status` | `VARCHAR` | `Completed`, `Scheduled`, or `No Show`. |
| `requestor_organization` | `VARCHAR` | Organization that requested the meeting (e.g. a trade association, company, advocacy group, or law firm). |
| `requestor_name` | `VARCHAR` | Contact person for the requesting organization. |
| `summary` | `VARCHAR` | Meeting summary, when OIRA recorded one. Almost always null. |
| `source_file` | `VARCHAR` | reginfo.gov export the row came from (e.g. `EO_12866_Meeting_Data_First_Half_2024.xml`). |
| `url` | `VARCHAR` | URL of the meeting's reginfo.gov detail page, which lists all attendees and any documents handed over. Null when `meeting_id` is null. |
